capabilities.name: Multi-digit addition and subtraction with regrouping
capabilities.name_zh: 多位数加减法（含进位借位）
capabilities.description: Learner can accurately add and subtract multi-digit whole numbers with carrying and borrowing.

capabilities.name: Vertical multiplication algorithm
capabilities.description: Learner can multiply a multi-digit number by a one- or two-digit number using the standard vertical algorithm.

capabilities.name: Vertical division algorithm with remainder
capabilities.description: Learner can divide multi-digit numbers by one- or two-digit divisors using the vertical algorithm, obtaining quotient and remainder.

capabilities.name: Order of operations with parentheses
capabilities.name_zh: 含括号的混合运算顺序
capabilities.description: Learner can correctly evaluate mixed arithmetic expressions containing addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and parentheses.

capabilities.name: Computational shortcuts via distributive/associative law
capabilities.description: Learner can split, combine or reorder factors/divisors (e.g. a÷(b×c)=a÷b÷c) to simplify a calculation.

capabilities.name: Division check relationship
capabilities.description: Learner can verify a division result using dividend = quotient × divisor + remainder.

capabilities.name: Place-value reasoning for repeated-digit sums
capabilities.description: Learner can use place-value decomposition to quickly add numbers formed by permuting the same digits.

capabilities.name: Solve for an unknown symbol in a numeric equation
capabilities.description: Learner can find the value of an unknown symbol in an equation by applying inverse operations step by step.

capabilities.name: Solve simple one-variable linear equations
capabilities.description: Learner can expand brackets and collect terms to solve a simple linear equation such as 4x+4=6+(8-x).

capabilities.name: Compare decimals by place value
capabilities.description: Learner can compare two decimals by comparing digits place by place from left to right.

capabilities.name: Effect of moving the decimal point
capabilities.name_zh: 小数点移动引起的大小变化
capabilities.description: Learner can state how a number's magnitude changes when its decimal point is moved left or right by given places.

capabilities.name: Solve decimal-point-relocation difference problems
capabilities.name_zh: 小数点位置变化差值问题
capabilities.description: Learner can use place-value ratio reasoning to find an original decimal when moving its decimal point creates a stated numeric difference.

capabilities.name: Estimate the digit-length of a quotient
capabilities.description: Learner can reason about whether a division's quotient will have one fewer or the same number of digits as the dividend by comparing leading digits.

capabilities.name: Comprehensive arithmetic computation fluency
capabilities.description: Learner can fluently combine all the above computation skills to correctly evaluate any multi-step arithmetic expression taught in the course.

capabilities.name: Sum-and-difference problems
capabilities.description: Learner can find two quantities given their sum and their difference.

capabilities.name: Sum-and-multiple problems
capabilities.description: Learner can find two quantities given their sum and a stated multiple relationship between them.

capabilities.name: Difference-and-multiple problems
capabilities.description: Learner can find two quantities given their difference and a stated multiple relationship between them.

capabilities.name: Transfer-then-ratio problems
capabilities.description: Learner can solve problems where one quantity is given to another, changing their ratio, by working out the resulting share structure.

capabilities.name: Age problems with time-shift alignment
capabilities.description: Learner can align two people's ages across time using a timeline to find an unknown current or past age.

capabilities.name: Recognise the relational word-problem type
capabilities.name_zh: 识别关系类应用题类型
capabilities.description: Learner can read a word problem and decide whether it is a sum-difference, sum-multiple, or difference-multiple structure before solving it.

capabilities.name: Multi-step relational word problems
capabilities.description: Learner can solve word problems that combine several sum/difference/multiple relationships in sequence.

capabilities.name: Unitary-rate (unit-value) problems
capabilities.description: Learner can find a per-unit rate from given data and scale it to answer a new quantity question.

capabilities.name: Rate problems with changing group size
capabilities.description: Learner can solve work/production-rate problems where the number of workers, days, or units changes, including partial participation.

capabilities.name: Surplus-and-deficit problems
capabilities.description: Learner can use the difference between two allocation scenarios (surplus/shortfall) to find the number of people/items involved.

capabilities.name: Infer group size from remainder constraints
capabilities.description: Learner can determine an unknown number of people or groups by testing values against stated division-with-remainder conditions.

capabilities.name: Average problems with overlapping subgroups
capabilities.name_zh: 平均数与部分组合问题
capabilities.description: Learner can use total = average × count on overlapping subgroups to isolate an unknown individual or group value.

capabilities.name: Basic meeting (opposite-direction) problems
capabilities.description: Learner can find meeting time or distance for two objects starting at the same time and moving toward each other.

capabilities.name: Staggered-departure meeting problems
capabilities.description: Learner can adjust for one traveller starting earlier than the other before applying the meeting-problem method.

capabilities.name: Interrupted-journey meeting problems
capabilities.description: Learner can treat a mid-journey delay as equivalent to a later start when solving a meeting problem.

capabilities.name: Catch-up (same-direction) problems
capabilities.description: Learner can use the speed difference and distance gap to find the time or distance needed for one traveller to catch another.

capabilities.name: Recognise the motion-problem type
capabilities.description: Learner can determine whether a travel problem is a meeting, catch-up, staggered-start, or separating scenario and set it up accordingly.

capabilities.name: Moving-apart distance problems
capabilities.name_zh: 背向而行/距离增加问题
capabilities.description: Learner can compute the resulting distance between two objects that start apart and move further apart or combine an initial gap with subsequent travel.

capabilities.name: Complex motion word problems
capabilities.description: Learner can solve motion problems that combine staggered starts, interruptions, and multiple travellers in one scenario.

capabilities.name: Work-backwards multi-step reversal problems
capabilities.description: Learner can reverse a sequence of described operations (cutting, taking, halving, etc.) step by step to recover an original quantity.

capabilities.name: Classic chicken-and-rabbit (assumption) problems
capabilities.description: Learner can use the 'assume all one type' substitution method to find the counts of two types of items from totals of heads and legs.

capabilities.name: Generalised multi-type invariant-sum problems
capabilities.name_zh: 多类型头脚（不变量）问题
capabilities.description: Learner can find an invariant combined quantity across more than two item types to solve extended head/leg-style problems.

capabilities.name: Rectangle/square area and perimeter computation
capabilities.name_zh: 长（正）方形周长面积计算
capabilities.description: Learner can compute the area and perimeter of a rectangle or square directly from given dimensions.

capabilities.name: Find a missing side from area or perimeter
capabilities.description: Learner can use inverse formulas to find an unknown side length given the area or perimeter and other dimensions.

capabilities.name: Parallelogram area with correct base-height pairing
capabilities.name_zh: 平行四边形面积（底高匹配）
capabilities.description: Learner can compute a parallelogram's area by correctly identifying which height corresponds to which base among distractors.

capabilities.name: Trapezoid area formula application
capabilities.description: Learner can compute a trapezoid's area using (top+bottom)×height÷2.

capabilities.name: Irregular orthogonal-figure perimeter by edge tracing
capabilities.name_zh: 不规则图形周长（描边法）
capabilities.description: Learner can find the perimeter of an irregular right-angled figure by tracing and summing all its edges, cancelling opposite offsets.

capabilities.name: Irregular-figure perimeter/area via translation
capabilities.name_zh: 平移法求不规则图形周长/面积
capabilities.description: Learner can mentally translate parts of an irregular figure to form an equivalent rectangle for easy perimeter/area calculation.

capabilities.name: Sum of perimeters after partitioning a rectangle
capabilities.name_zh: 分割长方形后周长总和
capabilities.description: Learner can compute the total perimeter of all pieces after a rectangle is cut into smaller rectangles, using the 'each cut adds a fixed length' rule.

capabilities.name: Find an unknown sub-rectangle's dimension in a partition
capabilities.name_zh: 分割图中未知小长方形的求解
capabilities.description: Learner can use whole-minus-known-parts or proportional reasoning to find an unknown sub-rectangle's perimeter or area within a partitioned figure.

capabilities.name: Border/frame area computation
capabilities.description: Learner can compute the area of a border or path surrounding or bordering a given shape.

capabilities.name: Equation setup from a described area change
capabilities.name_zh: 由面积变化列方程求边长
capabilities.description: Learner can set up and solve a simple equation for an unknown side length from a description of how enlarging sides changes area.

capabilities.name: Proportional reasoning between decomposed regions
capabilities.name_zh: 图形分解后的比例关系求面积
capabilities.description: Learner can use the ratio between corresponding decomposed parts of two related figures to find an unknown area.

capabilities.name: Composite perimeter/area problem solving
capabilities.name_zh: 复合图形周长面积综合解决
capabilities.description: Learner can solve composite perimeter and area problems by choosing decomposition, transformation, or proportional reasoning as appropriate.

capabilities.name: Count angles at a shared vertex
capabilities.description: Learner can count all distinct angles formed by several rays sharing a common vertex.

capabilities.name: Count triangles in a subdivided figure
capabilities.description: Learner can systematically label and combine regions to count all triangles in a subdivided or overlapping figure.

capabilities.name: Count squares of multiple sizes in a grid
capabilities.description: Learner can count squares of every possible size within a grid using the size-by-size counting method.

capabilities.name: Count rectangles of multiple sizes in a grid
capabilities.description: Learner can count rectangles of every possible size within a grid using row/column combination counting.

capabilities.name: Addition-principle counting
capabilities.description: Learner can count total possibilities by adding counts of mutually exclusive categories.

capabilities.name: Multiplication-principle counting
capabilities.description: Learner can count total possibilities by multiplying the number of choices at each independent step.

capabilities.name: Recognise addition vs multiplication principle
capabilities.name_zh: 识别加法/乘法原理适用情形
capabilities.description: Learner can decide whether a counting problem requires adding category counts or multiplying step counts.

capabilities.name: Count digit-constrained numbers by case-splitting
capabilities.name_zh: 数字组数问题（分类枚举）
capabilities.description: Learner can count numbers formed from given digits under constraints such as no repetition, leading-zero rules, or adjacency conditions, using case-splitting.

capabilities.name: Count map/region colourings under constraints
capabilities.description: Learner can count the number of valid colourings of adjacent regions using case analysis by colour reuse.

capabilities.name: Count shortest grid paths with constraints
capabilities.description: Learner can count shortest paths on a grid moving only in allowed directions, accounting for forbidden points.

capabilities.name: Count non-repeating paths on a small network
capabilities.name_zh: 网络图不重复路径计数
capabilities.description: Learner can count distinct routes between two points on a small graph without repeating a vertex or edge.

capabilities.name: Count outcomes of a circular rotation/passing game
capabilities.description: Learner can determine the position or holder of an item after many steps of a cyclic passing process using modular counting.

capabilities.name: Count recursive multi-step passing patterns
capabilities.description: Learner can enumerate, via a tree diagram or recursive reasoning, all distinct sequences of several passing steps that return to the start.

capabilities.name: Enumerate integer partitions into fixed parts
capabilities.description: Learner can list all ways to split a number into a given number of positive integer parts subject to constraints such as minimum value or distinctness.

capabilities.name: Maximum intersection points from lines/points
capabilities.description: Learner can compute the maximum number of intersection points among a set of lines using the pairwise (triangular-number) counting formula.

capabilities.name: Comprehensive counting problem solving
capabilities.description: Learner can solve unfamiliar counting problems by selecting and combining the appropriate enumeration principles.

capabilities.name: Find the nth term of a periodic pattern
capabilities.description: Learner can identify a repeating cycle in a sequence and use division with remainder to find the value at a given position.

capabilities.name: Find a term in an arithmetic sequence
capabilities.description: Learner can use the common difference to find a specified term of an arithmetic sequence.

capabilities.name: Sum an arithmetic sequence
capabilities.description: Learner can apply the sum formula (first+last)×count÷2 to find the sum of an arithmetic sequence.

capabilities.name: Locate a term in a number table by row and column
capabilities.description: Learner can determine the row and column position of a given number in a systematically arranged number table.

capabilities.name: Solve calendar date-arithmetic problems
capabilities.description: Learner can use the fixed row/column differences of a calendar grid to find dates satisfying a given sum condition.

capabilities.name: Solve state-dependent sequential-rule problems
capabilities.name_zh: 规则随状态变化的报数问题
capabilities.description: Learner can track a sequence whose generating rule changes depending on the current term's form (e.g., one-digit vs two-digit) to find a later term.

capabilities.name: Comprehensive sequence/pattern analysis
capabilities.description: Learner can analyse an unfamiliar sequence or table to discover its rule and compute any requested term or sum.

capabilities.name: Classify numbers as odd or even
capabilities.description: Learner can classify a number as odd or even from its last digit.

capabilities.name: Determine divisibility/multiples
capabilities.description: Learner can determine whether one number is a multiple of another.

capabilities.name: Count multiples of a number within a range
capabilities.description: Learner can count how many multiples of a given number lie within a specified range.

capabilities.name: Inclusion–exclusion for counting multiples
capabilities.description: Learner can use inclusion-exclusion to count numbers in a range divisible by either of two given numbers.

capabilities.name: Remainder-scaling rule
capabilities.name_zh: 余数随被除数除数同倍变化规律
capabilities.description: Learner can state and apply the rule that scaling both dividend and divisor by the same factor scales the remainder by that factor too.

capabilities.name: Comprehensive number-theory reasoning
capabilities.description: Learner can apply divisibility, remainder, and multiple-counting reasoning to solve number-theoretic word problems.

capabilities.name: Two-set overlap (inclusion-exclusion) problems
capabilities.description: Learner can find only-A, only-B, and both quantities from two overlapping groups using inclusion-exclusion.

capabilities.name: Three-set overlap (inclusion-exclusion) problems
capabilities.description: Learner can find region-specific counts among three overlapping groups using inclusion-exclusion or Venn-diagram reasoning.

capabilities.name: Comprehensive set-overlap reasoning
capabilities.name_zh: 集合重叠问题综合解决
capabilities.description: Learner can solve multi-set overlap word problems using inclusion-exclusion reasoning.

capabilities.name: Assignment/matching logic puzzles
capabilities.description: Learner can use an elimination table built from given clues to deduce a unique assignment among people and categories.

capabilities.name: Cryptarithmetic column-carry deduction
capabilities.description: Learner can deduce unknown digits in a verbal-arithmetic puzzle by analysing column sums and carries.

capabilities.name: Count solutions to a cryptarithmetic puzzle
capabilities.description: Learner can count the number of valid digit assignments satisfying all constraints of a cryptarithmetic puzzle.

capabilities.name: Magic-square deduction
capabilities.description: Learner can use row/column/diagonal equal-sum constraints to deduce missing entries in a magic-square-style grid.

capabilities.name: Round-robin tournament game-count deduction
capabilities.description: Learner can deduce how many games a given competitor has played using pairing/degree reasoning in a round-robin schedule.

capabilities.name: Comprehensive logic-puzzle deduction
capabilities.description: Learner can solve constraint-satisfaction logic puzzles (assignment, cryptarithmetic, magic square, tournament) through systematic deduction.

capabilities.name: Determine vertex degree in a network diagram
capabilities.name_zh: 网络图中点的奇偶性判断
capabilities.description: Learner can count the number of edges meeting at each point (vertex) of a network diagram and classify it as odd or even.

capabilities.name: Determine one-stroke traceability
capabilities.description: Learner can decide whether a figure can be drawn in one continuous stroke based on its number of odd-degree vertices.

capabilities.name: Determine valid start/end points for one-stroke drawing
capabilities.description: Learner can identify which two points must serve as start and end when a figure has exactly two odd vertices.

capabilities.name: Shortest route covering all edges with repeats
capabilities.name_zh: 重复走边的最短路径问题
capabilities.description: Learner can find the minimum-length route that traverses every edge of a network and returns to start by repeating the fewest necessary edges.

capabilities.name: Comprehensive network/graph reasoning
capabilities.description: Learner can analyse a network's vertex degrees to solve one-stroke-drawing and route-covering problems.

capabilities.name: Hollow-array layer relationships
capabilities.description: Learner can state and use the fact that adjacent layers of a hollow square array differ by 8 items.

capabilities.name: Compute counts in solid/hollow square arrays
capabilities.name_zh: 实心/空心方阵总数计算
capabilities.description: Learner can compute the total or per-layer number of items in a square array given partial information.

capabilities.name: Linear tree-planting/interval problems
capabilities.description: Learner can count trees or intervals on a straight path, correctly adjusting for whether one, both, or neither endpoint has a tree.

capabilities.name: Circular tree-planting/interval problems
capabilities.description: Learner can count trees or intervals around a closed loop, recognising that no endpoint adjustment is needed.

capabilities.name: Two-sided/multi-row interval extension
capabilities.description: Learner can extend interval-counting reasoning by multiplying when trees are planted on both sides of a road or in multiple rows.

capabilities.name: Read values from a bar chart
capabilities.description: Learner can read and extract quantities directly from a bar chart to answer questions.

capabilities.name: Combine values from statistical tables/charts
capabilities.description: Learner can combine multiple values from a data table or chart to compute totals, differences, or proportions.

capabilities.name: Compute elapsed time between clock readings
capabilities.description: Learner can find the duration between two given clock times.

capabilities.name: Determine day of the week after n days
capabilities.description: Learner can use modular arithmetic (remainder after dividing by 7) to determine the day of the week after a given number of days.

capabilities.name: Convert a fraction-of-total description into an absolute amount
capabilities.description: Learner can compute the absolute quantity corresponding to a stated fraction of a total in order to compare it with another quantity.

capabilities.name: Apply the pigeonhole principle
capabilities.description: Learner can use worst-case ('most unfavourable') reasoning to find the minimum count needed to guarantee a required outcome.

capabilities.name: Solve page-numbering digit-count problems
capabilities.description: Learner can relate the total number of digits printed when numbering pages to the number of pages, accounting for 1-, 2-, and 3-digit page ranges.

capabilities.name: Map an indexing problem onto another number base
capabilities.name_zh: 数制映射解决排序问题
capabilities.description: Learner can recognise a bijection between a restricted-digit counting sequence and another number base (e.g. binary) to find a required term.

capabilities.name: Use tree diagrams for systematic enumeration
capabilities.description: Learner can draw and use a tree diagram to systematically list all outcomes of a constrained arrangement or sequence problem.

capabilities.name: Translate word-problem statements into arithmetic expressions
capabilities.name_zh: 应用题语言转化为算式
capabilities.description: Learner can convert the relational statements of a word problem into a correct arithmetic or algebraic expression before computing.

capabilities.name: Verify a solution against all problem conditions
capabilities.description: Learner can check a computed answer by substituting it back into every stated condition of the problem to confirm consistency.

capabilities.name: Identify problem type and select solution strategy
capabilities.name_zh: 综合识别题型并选择解法
capabilities.description: Given an unfamiliar problem from the course's range, learner can correctly identify its underlying type and select and execute the appropriate solving strategy.
